title: Robust-GCD
abstract: arXiv:2611.18673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) classifies an unlabeled pool that contains both known and novel classes, given labels for the known classes only. Existing GCD methods assume that every un- labeled image is clean, but unlabeled data collected in the wild is often degraded by blur, sensor noise and compression artifacts. We formalize the setting in which an unknown fraction of the unlabeled pool is corrupted by an unknown operator as Degraded Generalized Category Discovery (D-GCD). To tackle it, we propose Robust-GCD, a framework that estimates the corruption directly from the unlabeled pool and uses the estimate to build labeled anchors for known classes and pseudo-anchors for novel classes inside the corrupted region of feature space. A trust curriculum controls how much the unlabeled pool is trusted while the anchors take hold, and a paired alignment loss keeps a clean image and its corrupted twin close in feature space. Across f

translated_title: Robust-GCD：面向退化数据的鲁棒广义类别发现
translated_abstract: 广义类别发现（GCD）的任务是在仅有已知类别标签的情况下，对同时包含已知类别和新类别的无标注数据池进行分类。现有的GCD方法假设每一张无标注图像都是干净的，但在真实场景中采集的无标注数据常常因模糊、传感器噪声和压缩伪影而发生退化。我们将无标注数据池中未知比例的数据被未知算子破坏这一设定形式化为退化广义类别发现（D-GCD）。为解决该问题，我们提出Robust-GCD框架，该框架直接从无标注数据池中估计退化情况，并利用该估计在特征空间的退化区域内为已知类别构建带标签的锚点、为新类别构建伪锚点。信任课程机制在锚点逐步建立的过程中控制对无标注数据池的信任程度，而成对对齐损失则使干净图像与其退化版本在特征空间中保持接近。在多个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Robust-GCD框架，形式化了无标注数据存在未知退化的新任务D-GCD，通过直接从无标注池估计退化程度来构建已知类锚点与新类伪锚点，并结合信任课程和成对对齐损失，实现了退化数据下的鲁棒广义类别发现。
en_tdlr: Robust-GCD formalizes the Degraded Generalized Category Discovery (D-GCD) setting and proposes a framework that estimates corruption directly from the unlabeled pool, using labeled anchors, pseudo-anchors, a trust curriculum, and a paired alignment loss to achieve robust classification of known and novel classes on degraded unlabeled data.
